description: Episode de pollution par les départements du Calvados, de l'Eure, de la Manche, de l'orne et de la Seine Maritime de la région Normandie de la veille jusqu'au lendemain is a dataset listed in Geocatalogue France, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by atmonormandie.fr. Level of vigilance air pollution for the air basins of the Normandy region for the day before, the same day and the next day. Coverage: FR. The portal shows the English title as "Episode of pollution by the departments of Calvados, Eure, Channel, Orne and Seine Maritime of the Normandy region from " (machine-translated by the portal). Its keywords include dioxyde d'azote, polluant atmosphérique, ozone, zone de pollution potentielle, particules PM10, opendata. The listing shows 2020-10-12 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support transport network, traffic and access studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-geocatalogue-fr.
